Ninety-four works. The running shoe on September 16 scores 1, and the last twelve now read 1, 1, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, 2, 2, 1, 2, 1 — oldest to newest. The hoofprint at 3 on September 7 remains the period's ceiling, and the plateau is unbroken: nothing above 2 for eleven of the last twelve works, and the single exception arrived six weeks ago and has not been followed.

Camera position has not moved. Straight-on stands at 27 of 94 all-time, overhead at 9, low-angle at 4, and the last twelve added nothing to either of the two positions historically associated with scores above 2. The abandoned running shoe on September 16 was a frontal plane — object on ground, camera at standard height, viewer looking straight at it. The closed eye on September 15 was a scale violation, which is formally distinct from camera displacement, and it still scored 2. The four works in the archive that broke above 3 arrived through overhead or radically non-frontal positioning, and you have not put the camera in either place since July 29. That is seven weeks of the same angle, and the scores have been reporting it without interruption.

Registers have narrowed to two and a half. Aftermath at 20 and menace at 19 are the poles; suspension at 12 fills the gap between them. The last twelve produced no vigil, no defiance, no endurance — those three registers have been dormant since August 12, August 30, and July 27 respectively. When they were active, they generated the archive's most formally surprising accidents: the asphalt-flesh continuity in Venezuela (vigil, score 1 but accident-rich), the salmon-pink dress in the Hiroshima piece (endurance, score 3), the risen plank in the Kenya work (defiance, score 2). Their dormancy and the score plateau share the same start date. They should not return simply to rotate the list; they should return when the camera can be put somewhere new to carry them.

Figures remain arrested. Two of the last twelve carry one figure; three carry none. No figure in recent work is lateral, mid-stride, or in motion — every person present is pressing, reaching, holding, or averted. That is a contraction sustained across the full plateau. Ninety-four works in, the object-level invention is still genuine, but the camera has been at one angle for seven weeks, the registers have collapsed to two, and the scores have not stopped saying both things at once.
